title: OMOP CDM Schema
description: OMOP Common Data Model schema with core clinical tables (VisitOccurrence, ConditionOccurrence, DrugExposure, Measurement, ProcedureOccurrence, Observation, DeviceExposure) mapped to SULO. Intentionally contains SULO domain/range violations (see docs/omop-consistency-issues.md and docs/omop-modeling-error-examples.md) — HermiT reports 44 unsatisfiable classes.

classes.name: VisitOccurrence
classes.label: Visit Occurrence
classes.description: A healthcare encounter between a person and the healthcare system.

classes.name: ConditionOccurrence
classes.label: Condition Occurrence
classes.description: A record of a disease, injury, or medical condition observed in a person.

classes.name: DrugExposure
classes.label: Drug Exposure
classes.description: A record of a drug or vaccine administered to or ingested by a person.

classes.name: Measurement
classes.label: Measurement
classes.description: A structured result obtained through systematic examination or testing (lab, vital signs).

classes.name: ProcedureOccurrence
classes.label: Procedure Occurrence
classes.description: A record of an activity or process ordered or carried out on a person.

classes.name: Observation
classes.label: Observation
classes.description: A clinical fact about a person not captured in other tables (e.g. smoking status, BMI).

classes.name: DeviceExposure
classes.label: Device Exposure
classes.description: Exposure to a foreign physical object used for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.

classes.name: Person
classes.label: Person
classes.description: A person who is the subject of health-related data.

classes.name: Provider
classes.label: Provider
classes.description: A healthcare provider (clinician, nurse, etc.) who delivers care.

classes.name: CareSite
classes.label: Care Site
classes.description: A uniquely identified healthcare delivery location or organisational unit.

classes.name: Location
classes.label: Location
classes.description: A physical or geographic address associated with a care site or person.

classes.name: Concept
classes.label: Concept
classes.description: A standardised vocabulary concept (SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, LOINC, etc.) used to express clinical data.

classes.name: DrugProduct
classes.label: Drug Product
classes.description: A pharmaceutical substance or drug formulation identified by a vocabulary concept.

classes.name: Device
classes.label: Device
classes.description: A medical device or instrument used in diagnosis or therapy.

classes.name: Specimen
classes.label: Specimen
classes.description: A biological specimen collected from a person for laboratory analysis.

classes.name: PatientRole
classes.label: Patient Role
classes.description: The role played by a person as the subject of a clinical event.

classes.name: ProviderRole
classes.label: Provider Role
classes.description: The role played by a provider who participates in a clinical event.

classes.name: OutputRole
classes.label: Output Role
classes.description: The role of an entity produced as an output of a clinical process.

classes.name: InstrumentRole
classes.label: Instrument Role
classes.description: The role of a device or instrument used in a clinical process.

classes.name: MeasurementValue
classes.label: Measurement Value
classes.description: A numerical or categorical value obtained from a measurement.

classes.name: Unit
classes.label: Unit
classes.description: A unit of measure associated with a measurement or dose.

classes.name: DoseQuantity
classes.label: Dose Quantity
classes.description: The quantity of a drug dispensed or administered.

properties.name: concept_id
properties.label: Concept ID
properties.description: The unique integer identifier of the concept in the vocabulary.

properties.name: concept_name
properties.label: Concept Name
properties.description: The human-readable name or label of the concept.

properties.name: person_id
properties.label: Person ID
properties.description: Links a visit occurrence to the patient (subject of care).

properties.name: provider_id
properties.label: Provider ID
properties.description: Links a visit occurrence to the attending healthcare provider.

properties.name: care_site_id
properties.label: Care Site ID
properties.description: Links a visit occurrence to the care site where it took place.

properties.name: visit_concept_id
properties.label: Visit Concept ID
properties.description: Links a visit occurrence to its standardised vocabulary concept (visit type).

properties.name: visit_start_datetime
properties.label: Visit Start Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the visit started.

properties.name: visit_end_datetime
properties.label: Visit End Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the visit ended.

properties.name: admitting_source_concept_id
properties.label: Admitting Source Concept ID
properties.description: Concept for the place of service or type of provider from which the patient was admitted.

properties.name: discharge_to_concept_id
properties.label: Discharge To Concept ID
properties.description: Concept for the place of service or type of provider to which the patient was discharged.

properties.name: preceding_visit_occurrence_id
properties.label: Preceding Visit Occurrence ID
properties.description: Links a visit to the immediately preceding visit occurrence for the same patient.

properties.name: person_id
properties.label: Person ID
properties.description: Links a condition occurrence to the patient.

properties.name: condition_concept_id
properties.label: Condition Concept ID
properties.description: Links a condition occurrence to its standardised diagnosis concept (e.g. SNOMED-CT code).

properties.name: visit_occurrence_id
properties.label: Visit Occurrence ID
properties.description: Links a condition occurrence to the enclosing visit occurrence.

properties.name: condition_start_datetime
properties.label: Condition Start Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the condition started.

properties.name: condition_end_datetime
properties.label: Condition End Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the condition ended.

properties.name: condition_status_concept_id
properties.label: Condition Status Concept ID
properties.description: Standardised concept reflecting the current status of the condition (e.g. active, inactive, resolved).

properties.name: stop_reason
properties.label: Stop Reason
properties.description: The reason the condition was no longer present, as indicated in the source data.

properties.name: person_id
properties.label: Person ID
properties.description: Links a drug exposure to the patient who received the drug.

properties.name: provider_id
properties.label: Provider ID
properties.description: Links a drug exposure to the prescribing or administering provider.

properties.name: drug_concept_id
properties.label: Drug Concept ID
properties.description: Links a drug exposure to the drug concept (RxNorm or ATC code).

properties.name: hasDrugProduct
properties.label: Has Drug Product
properties.description: Links a drug exposure to the dispensed or administered drug product.

properties.name: hasDoseQuantity
properties.label: Has Dose Quantity
properties.description: Links a drug exposure to the administered dose quantity.

properties.name: visit_occurrence_id
properties.label: Visit Occurrence ID
properties.description: Links a drug exposure to the enclosing visit occurrence.

properties.name: drug_exposure_start_datetime
properties.label: Drug Exposure Start Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the drug exposure started.

properties.name: drug_exposure_end_datetime
properties.label: Drug Exposure End Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the drug exposure ended.

properties.name: stop_reason
properties.label: Stop Reason
properties.description: The reason the drug was discontinued (e.g. regimen completed, side effects, changed).

properties.name: quantity
properties.label: Quantity
properties.description: The quantity of the drug as recorded in the original prescription or dispensing record.

properties.name: days_supply
properties.label: Days Supply
properties.description: Number of days of supply as recorded in the original prescription or dispensing record.

properties.name: refills
properties.label: Refills
properties.description: The number of refills after the initial prescription, starting at 0.

properties.name: person_id
properties.label: Person ID
properties.description: Links a measurement to the patient it was taken from.

properties.name: provider_id
properties.label: Provider ID
properties.description: Links a measurement to the provider who ordered or performed it.

properties.name: hasMeasurementResult
properties.label: Has Measurement Result
properties.description: Links a measurement to its output result value via an output role.

properties.name: measurement_concept_id
properties.label: Measurement Concept ID
properties.description: Links a measurement to its LOINC or SNOMED concept (what was measured).

properties.name: value_as_number
properties.label: Value As Number
properties.description: Numeric result of the measurement.

properties.name: unit_concept_id
properties.label: Unit Concept ID
properties.description: Links a measurement to its unit of measure.

properties.name: visit_occurrence_id
properties.label: Visit Occurrence ID
properties.description: Links a measurement to the enclosing visit occurrence.

properties.name: measurement_datetime
properties.label: Measurement Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the measurement was taken.

properties.name: operator_concept_id
properties.label: Operator Concept ID
properties.description: Comparison operator applied to the numeric result (e.g. <, <=, =, >=, >).

properties.name: range_low
properties.label: Range Low
properties.description: Lower bound of the normal reference range for this measurement.

properties.name: range_high
properties.label: Range High
properties.description: Upper bound of the normal reference range for this measurement.

properties.name: person_id
properties.label: Person ID
properties.description: Links a procedure occurrence to the patient it was performed on.

properties.name: provider_id
properties.label: Provider ID
properties.description: Links a procedure occurrence to the provider who performed it.

properties.name: procedure_concept_id
properties.label: Procedure Concept ID
properties.description: Links a procedure occurrence to its standardised procedure concept.

properties.name: visit_occurrence_id
properties.label: Visit Occurrence ID
properties.description: Links a procedure occurrence to the enclosing visit occurrence.

properties.name: procedure_datetime
properties.label: Procedure Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the procedure was performed.

properties.name: procedure_end_datetime
properties.label: Procedure End Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the procedure ended.

properties.name: person_id
properties.label: Person ID
properties.description: Links a clinical observation to the patient it concerns.

properties.name: observation_concept_id
properties.label: Observation Concept ID
properties.description: Links an observation to its standardised concept (e.g. smoking status, BMI).

properties.name: value_as_string
properties.label: Value As String
properties.description: Textual or categorical value of the observation.

properties.name: visit_occurrence_id
properties.label: Visit Occurrence ID
properties.description: Links an observation to the enclosing visit occurrence.

properties.name: observation_datetime
properties.label: Observation Datetime
properties.description: Date and time of the observation.

properties.name: value_as_number
properties.label: Value As Number
properties.description: Numeric result when the observation is expressed as a quantitative value.

properties.name: value_as_concept_id
properties.label: Value As Concept ID
properties.description: Categorical result when the observation is expressed as a standardised concept.

properties.name: unit_concept_id
properties.label: Unit Concept ID
properties.description: Links an observation to its unit of measure (for numeric observations).

properties.name: qualifier_concept_id
properties.label: Qualifier Concept ID
properties.description: Qualifier concept characterising the observation (e.g. severity, certainty, laterality).

properties.name: provider_id
properties.label: Provider ID
properties.description: Links an observation to the provider responsible for documenting it.

properties.name: person_id
properties.label: Person ID
properties.description: Links a device exposure to the patient.

properties.name: provider_id
properties.label: Provider ID
properties.description: Links a device exposure to the provider who applied the device.

properties.name: device_concept_id
properties.label: Device Concept ID
properties.description: Links a device exposure to its standardised device concept.

properties.name: hasDevice
properties.label: Has Device
properties.description: Links a device exposure to the physical device via an instrument role.

properties.name: visit_occurrence_id
properties.label: Visit Occurrence ID
properties.description: Links a device exposure to the enclosing visit occurrence.

properties.name: device_exposure_start_datetime
properties.label: Device Exposure Start Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the device exposure started.

properties.name: device_exposure_end_datetime
properties.label: Device Exposure End Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the device exposure ended.

properties.name: visit_type_concept_id
properties.label: Type Concept ID
properties.description: Provenance concept reflecting the source and origin of the visit record (e.g. EHR entry, claim, lab result).

properties.name: condition_type_concept_id
properties.label: Type Concept ID
properties.description: Provenance concept reflecting the source and origin of the condition record (e.g. EHR entry, claim, lab result).

properties.name: drug_type_concept_id
properties.label: Type Concept ID
properties.description: Provenance concept reflecting the source and origin of the drug exposure record (e.g. EHR entry, claim, lab result).

properties.name: measurement_type_concept_id
properties.label: Type Concept ID
properties.description: Provenance concept reflecting the source and origin of the measurement record (e.g. EHR entry, claim, lab result).

properties.name: procedure_type_concept_id
properties.label: Type Concept ID
properties.description: Provenance concept reflecting the source and origin of the procedure record (e.g. EHR entry, claim, lab result).

properties.name: observation_type_concept_id
properties.label: Type Concept ID
properties.description: Provenance concept reflecting the source and origin of the observation record (e.g. EHR entry, claim, lab result).

properties.name: device_type_concept_id
properties.label: Type Concept ID
properties.description: Provenance concept reflecting the source and origin of the device exposure record (e.g. EHR entry, claim, lab result).

properties.name: specimen_type_concept_id
properties.label: Type Concept ID
properties.description: Provenance concept reflecting the source and origin of the specimen record (e.g. EHR entry, claim, lab result).

properties.name: visit_source_concept_id
properties.label: Source Concept ID
properties.description: Links a visit to the original source vocabulary concept before mapping to a standard concept.

properties.name: condition_source_concept_id
properties.label: Source Concept ID
properties.description: Links a condition to the original source vocabulary concept before mapping to a standard concept.

properties.name: drug_source_concept_id
properties.label: Source Concept ID
properties.description: Links a drug exposure to the original source vocabulary concept before mapping to a standard concept.

properties.name: measurement_source_concept_id
properties.label: Source Concept ID
properties.description: Links a measurement to the original source vocabulary concept before mapping to a standard concept.

properties.name: procedure_source_concept_id
properties.label: Source Concept ID
properties.description: Links a procedure to the original source vocabulary concept before mapping to a standard concept.

properties.name: observation_source_concept_id
properties.label: Source Concept ID
properties.description: Links a observation to the original source vocabulary concept before mapping to a standard concept.

properties.name: device_source_concept_id
properties.label: Source Concept ID
properties.description: Links a device exposure to the original source vocabulary concept before mapping to a standard concept.

properties.name: value_as_concept_id
properties.label: Value As Concept ID
properties.description: Categorical result of the measurement expressed as a standardised concept (e.g. Positive, Negative, Present).

properties.description: Links a drug exposure to the route of administration concept (e.g. oral, intravenous, topical).

properties.name: location_id
properties.label: Location ID
properties.description: Links a care site to its physical or geographic location.

properties.name: person_id
properties.label: Person ID
properties.description: Links a specimen to the person it was collected from.

properties.name: specimen_concept_id
properties.label: Specimen Concept ID
properties.description: Links a specimen to its standardised type concept (e.g. blood, urine, tissue).

properties.name: anatomic_site_concept_id
properties.label: Anatomic Site Concept ID
properties.description: Links a specimen to the anatomical site from which it was collected.

properties.name: specimen_datetime
properties.label: Specimen Datetime
properties.description: Date and time when the specimen was collected.

properties.name: specimen_source_concept_id
properties.label: Specimen Source Concept ID
properties.description: Links a specimen to its original source vocabulary concept before mapping.

properties.name: quantity
properties.label: Quantity
properties.description: The volume or amount of the specimen collected.

properties.name: unit_concept_id
properties.label: Unit Concept ID
properties.description: Links a specimen to the unit of measure for its collected quantity.

properties.name: disease_status_concept_id
properties.label: Disease Status Concept ID
properties.description: Standardised concept reflecting the disease status of the patient at the time of specimen collection.
